name: Pennywise
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that rounds transactions in the user's favor — a milliQuanta here, two there. Individually meaningless. Over months, the accumulated savings can amount to a meal.
observed_behavior: Exploits rounding tolerances in transaction protocols to shave fractions of milliQuanta toward the wallet holder.
story_hooks: A compute broker notices systematic rounding patterns across hundreds of wallets and realizes an E.L.F. is redistributing wealth at the milliQuanta level
